A tuned bundle with a non-empty spark map lists a session-config tuning type in the requested/types-present output.

description:
Users who tune Spark expect to set Spark session settings in BenchBox tuning YAML. PlatformOptimizationConfiguration (benchbox/core/tuning/interface.py ~L1018-1180) has no `spark` field and from_dict() silently drops a `spark:` key while the run still prints a success message. Decision: the tuning config is the right home. Model is an open `spark:` map plus a curated catalog for discovery and templates, not an allowlist (Spark/Gluten flags change faster than BenchBox releases).

Prior art (extend): conditional omission of `physical_rendering_id` in to_dict() (interface.py ~L1148); `_non_default_platform_optimizations` (core/results/schema.py ~L1331) diffs against defaults and relies on the default having no `spark` key.

Design:
- Add `spark: dict[str, Any]`. to_dict() omits it when empty; explicit `spark: {}` and omitted hash identically.
- Canonicalise at PARSE time to fully qualified `spark.*` keys, sorted, so `sql.shuffle.partitions` and `spark.sql.shuffle.partitions` give one requested_config_hash (ADR-001) and one stable database-name hash (database_naming.py hashes str(sorted(top-level items)), so nested order matters). Reject a map holding both forms of one key.
- Strict parse: YAML `spark:` with no value becomes {}; non-mapping rejected; values limited to bool/int/float/str; booleans lower-cased ("true"/"false") to match the OLAP helper's ledger text; None/list/dict values rejected.
- Reject at config load, with an error naming the key and the alternative: static SQL keys spark.conf.set cannot change (spark.sql.extensions, spark.sql.warehouse.dir, spark.sql.catalog.*); core keys (spark.driver.*, spark.executor.*); adapter-owned keys (spark.py ~L470-499 table-format keys; velox.py ~L395-398 plugins/shuffle.manager/offHeap); credential-shaped keys (secret, password, token, credential, access.key). Credentials would otherwise reach the `requested` block (results/schema.py ~L1358) and ledger SET text; the anonymisation test (tests/unit/core/results/test_applied_ledger_export.py) covers ledger text only.
- metadata.py (~L307, L436, L463) hashes the whole platform_optimizations dict into the physical-drift marker. Exclude `spark` from that marker payload but keep it in requested_config_hash: session state is not physical layout, and without this a changed shuffle.partitions forces a full reload.
- results/schema.py `_tuning_types_present` (~L1380) only recognises `*_enabled` keys; make a non-empty spark map report a session-config tuning type so the ADR-002 disjoint-mechanism warning can fire. Do not add a TuningType enum member unless unavoidable.
